hook: An uploaded image can take over the server

beats.say: Upload2Shell is a use-after-free in Ghostscript's Type 1 font loader that escapes its safer sandbox and runs attacker commands. Ghostscript sits underneath print, email, upload and preview workflows.
Files named png or jpg can still reach Ghostscript through image conversion. Researchers confirmed routes in Google's document renderer, WordPress, Debian CUPS, Roundcube, DokuWiki and MediaWiki.
Found on July 27, it was fixed in Ghostscript 10.08.0 on September 8. Update Ghostscript wherever documents get rendered.
